title: Noetherian Chow lemma for spaces: embed after an admissible blow-up into a proper representable over projective space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a separated finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces with Y Noetherian, the lemma produces a dense open U of X and a diagram with a U-admissible blow-up X' -> X, an open immersion X' -> Z', a proper representable Z' -> Y factoring as a U-admissible blow-up Z' -> Z followed by a closed immersion Z -> P^n_Y, all compatible with U -> X over Y — the spaces-side Noetherian Chow's lemma driving the resolution-property machinery. The retained proof is written: an immersion of a dense open into affine space (Limits of Spaces, lemma embedding-into-affine-over-qs) composed with A^n_Y into P^n_Y puts the data exactly into the hypothesis shape of the chapter's blowup-to-find-embedding lemma (the improvement-after-blowup engine), whose conclusion is the displayed diagram. The reduction is two named moves; the diagram chase is the chapter lemma's content, invoked by number. Retained author proof at lines 9246-9254.
